objective: establish a reproducible Dice-first, official-category-2d nodule baseline before proposing later nodule-improvement training

audit.method: read and hash-pin pre-existing evaluator JSON, repo-local catalog artifacts, and released raw challenge metadata; do not load checkpoints, run inference, write predictions, launch training, or request GPUs

train_validation_distribution_audit.source_contract: the source SHA-256 and expected split aggregates are pinned in source_manifest
train_validation_distribution_audit.purpose: compare official category-2d train and validation description distributions and released entity-count density
train_validation_distribution_audit.location_provenance: findings text only; no lung/lobe masks, segmentation masks, CT images, coordinates, predictions, or image-derived localization
train_validation_distribution_audit.entity_provenance: released entity_counts metadata only; no segmentation-mask inspection
train_validation_distribution_audit.reproduction_requirement: the read-only raw metadata source must be available at the declared path with the manifest-pinned SHA-256

official_nodule_contract.label: Pulmonary nodules/masses
official_nodule_contract.ranking: single-model fixed-val200 checkpoints ordered by category-2d Dice descending, hits descending, then candidate ID ascending

evidence_policy.direct_2d_finetunes: list separately with target-census-only evidence labeled partial and available fixed-val200 evidence shown distinctly

downstream_decision.conclusion: No direct official-category-2d fine-tune has exceeded the broad Exp007 phase-2 continuation on fixed-val200 Dice.
downstream_decision.next_step: A nodule-only training matrix and GPU launch require a later, separate request.
